verses: I also saw the souls of several men, and several women, whose legs and necks and middle parts a noxious creature ever gnawed, and separated one from the other.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by these bodies, whose souls suffer such a punishment?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'These are the souls of those wicked ones who, in the world, walked without shoes, ran about uncovered, made water on foot, and performed other demon-service.'
